title: Exports built in the browser with no server authorisation, step-up or audit
status: Fixed locally - lead-verified in integration d4e920e (3 identical full runs, 3,014/3,014); database guard proposed only (P7-P15); production closure needs hosted/staging verification
evidence: Confirmed by code: downloadBlob src/lib/reports.ts:72-78 (all file exports, 18 screens call it); report-centre.tsx:163 corporateDownload (CSV/Excel/evidence/audit pack); backup.ts:79 createBackupZip (full data incl. receipts); statements.tsx:504, records-check.tsx:68, TeamAccess.tsx:153 CSV; no withStepUp in these paths; no export audit table in drizzle/migrations (only report_history for PDFs). docs/registers/blockers/production_release_blockers.csv RB-P1-02. Fix (11 Nov 2026, Track A): every download/share goes through src/lib/export-gate.ts (exportFile / exportDeliver): SHA-256, bytes and rows of the exact file, then the server function authoriseExport (exports.functions.ts → exports.ts) before anything is handed over; step-up prompt via withStepUp. 31 call sites on 19 screens routed (reports, report centre incl. company pack/evidence/history, statements, import review/reconciliation, audit evidence, period evidence, reconciliation details, tax filing JSON, trip/loan/brief/review, Finance company tax, shared-company CSV/PDF/Excel). Remaining direct downloads by design: store.downloadFile (a stored original through a one-minute signed URL that re-checks access) and the backup ZIP after its server authorisation. Proposed P15 (+rollback): export_audit (actor, data owner, company, kind, file, rows, bytes, SHA-256, step-up, time; append-only incl. TRUNCATE; visible to actor and owner) and authorise_export: own kinds only for the caller's records; shared company only with P2 has_permission(owner, company, 'export') (applied fallback: active entity_members grant for exactly that company); Finance company-tax list only for Finance with the company-tax switch; sensitive kinds (backup, evidence, company pack, tax filing, company tax) need a recent step-up where P4 is installed. Before P15 the server applies the same scope rules (own; entity_members grant; Finance switch) but cannot audit (audited:false). MCP tools are read-only RLS reads with no file export; the assistant produces no files. Before-run docs/evidence/p0-closure-2026-11-11/p0-006-exports.before.txt (no server check: X1-X4 fail). Tests: failure-injection.test.ts X1-X4 (owner, other user, company member c1 vs c2, Finance vs manager, P2 viewer without export, missing step-up, audit rows with rows/bytes/SHA-256, backup isolation), p15-export-sql.test.ts 3 (gate inventory; P15 install/append-only/catalog-exact rollback on applied schema and P1..P14).
